items.title: Kyiv bridge hit in further Russian drone attack as German chancellor makes surprise visit
items.description: Footage shows a drone hitting the Pivnichyi (Northern) Bridge as vehicles move across it, creating a large fireball.

items.title: Watch: What we know about Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges
items.description: BBC Ukraine correspondent Dan Johnson is near Kyiv's Northern Bridge, which has been hit for the second day in a row.

items.title: Yemen's government announces all-out war to reclaim land from Houthis
items.description: The Yemeni president's announcement comes amid an exchange of strikes between the Houthis and the Saudi-led coalition.

items.title: Polls close in Brazil as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remain neck and neck
items.description: If no candidate gets more than 50% of the vote, the election will go to a run-off on 25 October.

items.title: Ethiopian rebel forces withdraw from Tigray regional capital
items.description: Two residents in Mekelle tell the BBC pro-government forces have taken control of the city.

items.title: Christa Pike's prognosis still unclear after failed execution, lawyer says
items.description: Pike's lawyer says doctors are still trying to clear two lethal doses of pentobarbital from her body.

items.title: Indian police accused of sexually harassing journalists at protest
items.description: The allegations were made after police detained dozens of protesters demanding the resignation of the election chief over changes to voter rolls.

items.title: US Marine arrested over murder of woman in Okinawa, Japan
items.description: Japan's government lodged a formal protest with the US, demanding that military officials take action.

items.title: Australia investigating Flydubai co-pilot's links to country
items.description: State police and the country's security agency are looking into the co-pilot, who attempted to take control of a Flydubai plane travelling to Israel.

items.title: What to know about Brazil's election as Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro face off
items.description: Polls suggest the election will be a closely run contest between the left-wing incumbent and his right-wing rival.

items.title: 'Anger in the streets': Tens of thousands protest in Spain over housing crisis
items.description: More than 50 protests took place on Saturday after the government failed to get emergency legislation through parliament.

items.title: Rescuers suspend search for survivors after plane went missing off US coast
items.description: The aircraft lost communication with flight controllers after significantly dropping in altitude, according to flight data.
